description:
No spec subject (consumer repo migration; Engage)

Stage: M7 (05b-stages-migration.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu. Common migration checklist items 1-12 from 05b apply (see M6 for the expanded list).

Deliverable:
Engage PR: SHA ref to hex, keep only: [:dev, :test], runtime: false; strip 31 realized_by: / 28 api_boundary-era blocks / 101 execute:; delete realization_hashes.json (35 KB). Engage corpus is verified almost entirely by retired kinds (~104 source_file against ~9 tagged_tests entries): the migration ADR must state the spec/requirement_unverified count and whether any requirement-tagging follow-up is planned; its pruning pass will retire more of the corpus than any other repo. Lightest PR refers to mechanics, not corpus health; say so in the ADR. All common checklist items as in M6.

Verification:

- Behaviors to demonstrate: mix spec.check green on the PR head; format/retired_construct = 0; config/unknown_key = 0; realization_hashes.json deleted; migration ADR with counts, pruning list, and override reasons; .claude/rules/specled.md absent; retired-vocabulary grep zero
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix spec.check --base origin/main and mix spec.status in Engage
  - Final tier: Engage CI green
  - Verifier tier: checklist 1-12 against the diff; no suite runs
- Standing bounce-class checks: every checklist item ticked with evidence
- Call-site Integration: n/a

Out of Scope (files):
- /Users/mz/src/ancora/**
- any other consumer repo
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- Engage: mix.exs, mix.lock, .spec/**, .claude/**, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CI config if it names retired flags

Out of Scope (intent):
- never config-off a code without an ADR line; never edit spec text to dodge a finding
- a red on an unpriced finding class stops this PR

Merge gate:
- [ ] Engage CI green including the shim new path
- [ ] Checklist items 1-12 checked in the PR description

- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
